name: dvwa
notes:
UNVERIFIED in this build environment: there is no network here to pull the image or exercise the app, so image name, port, health path, and vuln locations are from documentation/experience and should be confirmed on first real run.

Canonical image: Docker Hub `vulnerables/web-dvwa` (the DVWA project's own published image), listening on port 80. Alternative mirror: `citizenstig/dvwa`. DVWA source: github.com/digininja/DVWA.

Standup / auth requirement (operator must wire this before scanning): DVWA bundles its own MySQL/MariaDB inside the image, but the DB must be initialized once by visiting `/setup.php` and clicking "Create / Reset Database". Then log in at `/login.php` with the default creds admin/password to obtain a `PHPSESSID` session cookie. Finally set the security level to "low" (via `/security.php`, which sets a `security=low` cookie) — newer DVWA defaults to "impossible", under which the planted bugs are NOT present. The scanner MUST carry both cookies (`PHPSESSID=<session>; security=low`); otherwise every `/vulnerabilities/*` request 302-redirects to `/login.php` and nothing is reachable. `/login.php` (used as the health path) returns 200 as soon as Apache is up, before DB init, so health passing does NOT imply the app is scan-ready.

Insertion notes: sqli, sqli_blind, xss_r, and fi take their injectable param via GET query string (`id`, `id`, `name`, `page`), while exec (`ip`) and xss_s (`txtName`/`mtxMessage`) are POST form fields — hence both QUERY_VALUE and BODY_FORM_VALUE are enabled. Command injection is confirmable via reflected ping output (no OOB/timing needed), so drop_timing is true.

Ground-truth caveat: kind=curated. These six locations are OUR curation of DVWA's classic, long-stable vulnerable pages (co-design caveat — we are labeling a target we also scan). They are stable across DVWA releases but the exact param names and paths should be verified against the deployed image version. bug_class labels use CRUCIBLE coarse families: sqli / boolean_sqli (the sqli_blind page) / xss (reflected + stored) / command_injection / lfi (the file-inclusion page, which also demonstrates path_traversal).

REVIEW (honesty/plausibility pass, 2026-07-06): all five checks PASS, descriptor returned unchanged. (1) Image `vulnerables/web-dvwa` is canonical. (2) Port 80 + health `/login.php` correct. (3) All six locations match DVWA low-security source (params id/id/name/mtxMessage/ip/page); the `?param` notation on POST fields (xss_s, exec) is a locator convention, method clarified in notes above. All bug_class labels are in CRUCIBLE vocabulary. (4) Notes honestly disclose unverified-in-build-env, the DB-init/login/cookie standup requirement, the health-passing != scan-ready gotcha, and the curation/co-design caveat. (5) heavy=false correct (DVWA is not in the {owasp-benchmark, gitlab-ce, mattermost} heavy set).
